note: The interface's exact copy, from content/script.md section 6. The story's own words are in the script.
title: One Bright Idea
tagline: One life. One invention. Someone takes it further.
framing: You will live many lives. You will not live forever. What you make might.
helperFirst: Swipe left or right to choose. You can also tap either answer.
helperSecond: Your choice changes what happens next. There is no timer.
revealFirst: One bright idea. It will outlive you.
revealAction: See what people do with it
archiveTransition: No one inherited all of it. Different people found different uses for what had survived. These are the projects waiting for their next inventor.
offerQuestion: Will this be the next work?
offerDeferred: Another workshop. Another problem worth solving.
offerHelp: Earlier choices suggest projects. You choose which one to follow.
museumEmpty: Nothing here yet. Start with a spark.
restartConfirm: Start again from the first spark? Your ending collection will remain.
credits: A game about what we leave for each other.
oldSave: A new history begins with a spark. Your earlier prototype save will be kept separately.
